# Paul Irving & Rachel Lynde

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — fond of him despite him being a Yankee · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing and everyone frantically searching for her. After searching the well and surrounding area with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted and tearfully promises never to lie again after realizing he made [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, though he later questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Marilla's warning regarding prayers.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares humorous anecdotes and student compositions from her teaching experience. The letter includes stories of classroom responses and student letters from Jacob, Annetta, Barbara, Willie, and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> After [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) dies, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) won't have to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), which also allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation and upcoming departure spreads among her students and friends, causing distress for [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to learn from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and fearing for his life. At dawn, she speaks with [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), who tells her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) passed the crisis and will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding guest list and plans with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Friends and guests, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) ahead of the ceremony, bringing news and gifts like Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reminiscing about their past together.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her time in her childhood room. Friends and family gather for the wedding ceremony in the orchard, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart on the train for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.
